question.text: What is the maximum permissible debt-to-equity ratio after a buyback under SEBI Buyback Regulations?

explanation.text: The Logic: After the buyback is completed, the ratio of the aggregate of secured and unsecured debts owed by the company must not exceed twice (2:1) the paid-up capital and free reserves. The Trap: 1:1 sounds conservative and reasonable, which is why candidates pick it, but the regulation specifically allows up to 2:1.
